parameters.content:
## Aura_Social_Campaign_Automation — Backend API (GCP)

### Endpoint
`POST https://<cloud-run-url>/webhook/aura-generate`
(n8n di Cloud Run — tidak perlu ngrok. URL dari `N8N_HOST` / domain Cloud Run.)

### Request body
```json
{
  "callbackUrl": "https://backend/api/aura/callback  (WAJIB)",
  "contentType": "image | carousel | video",
  "prompt": "prompt final",
  "prompts": ["slide 1", ...],        // carousel opsional
  "carouselCount": 4,                  // carousel opsional
  "aspectRatio": "image: 1:1|9:16|16:9|3:4|4:3|4:5  ·  video: 9:16|16:9",
  "videoDuration": 8|16|32|48,         // video, default 8
  "jobId": "...", "campaign": "...", "idea": "...", "caption": "..."
}
```

### Response sync
`{ "jobId": "...", "status": "accepted", "contentType": "..." }`

### Callback (async) ke callbackUrl
```json
{
  "jobId": "...", "status": "success|failed", "contentType": "...",
  "aspectRatio": "...", "videoDuration": 16,
  "content": {
    "kind": "image|video", "url": "https://storage.googleapis.com/<bucket>/<obj>",
    "gsUri": "gs://<bucket>/<obj>", "mimeType": "...", "bytes": 123
    // carousel: "kind":"carousel","count":3,"slides":[{url,gsUri,mimeType,bytes}, ...]
  },
  "tokens": { "input": 129, "output": 1073, "total": 1202, "estimated": false, "byStep": [...] },
  "restoreTokens": false, "restoreAmount": 0,
  "error": null, "generatedAt": "..."
}
```

### Yang HARUS di-set (node Config — klik & edit)
- `gcsBucket`  : nama GCS bucket
- `gcsPrefix`  : prefix path object (mis. `generated`)
- `filesDir`   : `/tmp/aura` (Cloud Run ephemeral)

### Kredensial
- Google Gemini (PaLM) API di 4 node Gemini (API key AI Studio)
- **Google Service Account** di node `GCS - Upload` (role `Storage Object Creator` di bucket)

### Cloud Run — setting wajib
- `--min-instances=1` + `--no-cpu-throttling` (CPU always allocated) — workflow lanjut kerja SETELAH balas HTTP
- `--timeout=3600` `--memory=2Gi` `--concurrency=4`
- Env: `N8N_RESTRICT_FILE_ACCESS_TO=/tmp/aura`, `NODES_EXCLUDE=["n8n-nodes-base.localFileTrigger"]`
- **ffmpeg** harus ada di image container (Dockerfile: `apt-get install -y ffmpeg`)
- `N8N_HOST` / `WEBHOOK_URL` = URL publik Cloud Run

### Batasan prototype
- Kontinuitas antar-scene video belum sempurna (tiap klip di-generate independen)
- Token image/carousel = estimasi (~1290 out/gambar) — node Gemini image tak lapor usage
- Video 48 dtk = 6 klip Veo, ~10–15 menit
